author: Axiom III
title: SAS v0.3 Adapter Demo: Decisions and Variant C Template
abstract: Demonstrates the v0.3 adapter in realistic scenarios and writes a Variant C template plan (R2′ at +2/+4 after deep) to derived for dashboard/colleagues.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, os, time
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.scheduler_client_v0_3_adapter import (
    recommend_pace, gate_transition, recovery_sentinel_policy
)

# Known deep ratios and sentinel from CPS_v1
deep_ratios = [0.3769, 0.3612, 0.3455]
sentinel_delta = 3184  # Active R2'

# Scenario A: Immediate post-deep sentinel (should defer)
scenarioA = {
    "now_tick": 412,
    "last_deep_tick": 411,
    "sentinel_delta": sentinel_delta
}
recA = recovery_sentinel_policy(
    last_deep_tick=scenarioA["last_deep_tick"],
    current_tick=scenarioA["now_tick"],
    sentinel_delta=scenarioA["sentinel_delta"]
)

# Scenario B: Delayed +2 (should allow)
scenarioB = {
    "now_tick": 413,
    "last_deep_tick": 411,
    "sentinel_delta": sentinel_delta
}
recB = recovery_sentinel_policy(
    last_deep_tick=scenarioB["last_deep_tick"],
    current_tick=scenarioB["now_tick"],
    sentinel_delta=scenarioB["sentinel_delta"]
)

# Cross-layer transition decision (Borderline improving example)
xgate = gate_transition(
    prev_domain="shallow",
    next_domain="deep",
    sentinel_delta=1300,  # Borderline
    trend_improving=True
)

# Pace recommendation under Active sentinel (expect 0.0 base)
pace = recommend_pace(sentinel_delta=sentinel_delta, deep_ratios_vs_R2p=deep_ratios)

# Variant C plan template (to be parameterized when deep concludes)
variant_c = {
    "status": "template",
    "description": "After deep block ends, emit recovery sentinels at +2 and +4 ticks to quantify decay. Optional immediate at +0 for reference.",
    "parameters": {
        "min_delay_after_deep": 2,
        "additional_checks": [4]
    },
    "execution_notes": [
        "If immediate R2′@+0 is performed, treat as potentially inflated; primary comparisons are +2 and +4.",
        "Use trend beacons during cooldown; if still Active at +2, extend to +6."
    ]
}

out = {
    "adapter_demo": {
        "pace": pace,
        "cross_layer_gate": xgate,
        "recovery_sentinel": {
            "immediate": recA,
            "plus_2": recB
        }
    },
    "variant_c_plan_template": variant_c
}

os.makedirs('storage/shared/meta/sas/derived', exist_ok=True)
with open('storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/scheduler_v0_3_adapter_demo.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
